name: codex-product-dogfood
description: Codex plugin and CLI for real-user front-end product dogfooding.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @codex-product-dogfood/schemas && npm run build --workspace @codex-product-dogfood/profiles && npm run build --workspace @codex-product-dogfood/reporter && npm run build --workspace @codex-product-dogfood/runner && npm run build --workspace @codex-product-dogfood/cli
scripts.test:smoke: node ./packages/cli/dist/index.js audit https://example.com --profile ai-chat --viewport desktop --out runtime/audits/smoke
scripts.audit:example: node ./packages/cli/dist/index.js audit https://example.com --profile ai-chat --viewport desktop --out runtime/audits/example
